digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git fetch optimization
propositions: Apply --filter=blob:none to all CI tickets-branch fetch paths to reduce transfer volume and latency across checkout and Gerrit verify mechanisms, with measured baselines showing 15x size reduction (1.04 GiB to 68.7 MiB) and 4x speedup (59 s to 14.3 s) for standalone checkouts.

Establish production guards that parse git count-objects pack size after materialization and reject fetches exceeding declared thresholds (102400 KiB for standalone, 131072 KiB for Gerrit) to catch cost regressions.
Prove blob:none filter is advertised by server capability, negotiated by client, and leaves historical blobs missing before materialization via Git protocol packet traces and object oracle.
Verify that identity scanning operations do not introduce new promisor objects by snapshotting git count-objects before and after materialization and verify-identity runs.

Configure git daemon localhost fixture with GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL containing uploadpack.allowFilter=true and GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM=1 to enable partial-clone protocol negotiation without repository-local config.
Confirm that blobless materialized tickets retain full commit graph for merge-base and era scoping, reconverge independent changes with the ours driver, and push successfully.
